result.description: Open-source local command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definition files to SVG/PNG/PDF.
result.auth_detail: No auth. Runs locally (npm/Docker); no hosted service, accounts or API keys.
result.access_detail: Gate audit: no vendor app review, listing, partner status or paid plan. Open-source npm package/Docker image, anyone installs free. Caveat: no hosted API, so a Composio toolkit must run mmdc (with headless Chromium) in its own sandbox. No per-user credentials exist to connect.
result.api_notes: Only the mmdc CLI and a Node.js `run(input, output, opts)` function (not semver-covered). No REST/GraphQL API. Single operation: render diagram to SVG/PNG/PDF.
result.blocker: No hosted API or auth; it is a local CLI needing Node and headless Chromium, so it fits a sandboxed executor, not a standard remote-API toolkit. Single render function only.

evidence.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
It's possible to call `mermaid-cli` via a Node.JS API.
This is a command-line interface (CLI) for [mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/).
